news.title: Worried About Amazon’s AI Bill? What If It’s Already Paid For?
news.summary: If you follow Amazon.com (AMZN) stock, you’ve heard the main worry. The company is spending a fortune to build out its artificial intelligence infrastructure, and with the stock having trailed the index over the past year, investors are clearly nervous about the size of the bill. The price appears to give little credit for this investment, with a trailing price-to-earnings multiple of 27.5, toward the low end of its 10-year range.
